lines.trans: Send in Miss Leopoldine Schneck!
Hello, tell us a bit about yourself.
I studied cinema in Paris.
I worked for an events agency.
Did you do a lot of music?
Yes, especially for concerts.
I organized circus performances.
Do you know our actors well?
I love all of ASK's artists.
You have lots of positive energy.
Thank you very much for that nice compliment.
The assistant job is difficult.
I am ready for this job.
That is perfect, we will think about it.

examples.text: Cette agence ne représente que des stars.

meanings.note: une agence artistique = a talent agency

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?
un grand artiste = a great artist

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.trans: You know a lot of people.

meanings.en: beaucoup de = a lot of, many

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
the standard greeting during the day
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.trans: Shall we go to the cinema?
Thank you for that nice compliment.

examples.text: Beyoncé a fait ça après son concert.
examples.trans: Beyoncé did that after her concert.

examples.text: On va au concert ce soir.
examples.trans: We're going to the concert tonight.

meanings.en: to know a person or place
ne rien connaître à = to know nothing about

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: to come in, to go in

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.text: Vous êtes bien plus jolie en vrai.
examples.trans: You're much prettier in real life.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
merci beaucoup = thank you very much

examples.text: Elle prend des cours de musique ancienne!

meanings.note: écouter de la musique = to listen to music; la musique ancienne = early music

examples.trans: I want to set up a meeting.

meanings.en: to organize, to arrange, to set up
un peu = a little, a bit

examples.text: Il y a un côté positif.
Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

meanings.en: to think, to think something over

examples.text: Le spectacle est à huit heures.

meanings.note: a play, a concert, a show on stage

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
travailler à Paris, travailler le dimanche
je vous rappelle = I'll call you back
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
